KOTLIN LICENSE SYSTEM — STATUS & ROADMAP
WORKING RIGHT NOW
• Product creation in admin app syncs to kl_products
• Product deletion in admin app cascades and cleans all 4 tables (kl_products, kl_licenses, kl_revocations, kl_demo_sessions)
• App injection generates all required Kotlin files (SHVApplication, SHVLicense, SHVAccount, LicenseGateScreen)
• Demo trial starts and writes correctly to kl_demo_sessions (fixed from legacy app_demo_entitlements)
• One-time trial enforcement per device per product
• License generation with correct UUID matching between token payload and Supabase record (fixed pendingLicenseId issue)
• License activation on patched app verifies cryptographic signature correctly
• License revocation flips kl_licenses status to revoked and writes to kl_revocations
• Patched app detects revocation on next launch and falls back to trial if available
• License gate screen is full AMOLED black theme
• RLS disabled on all 4 tables (intentional for now, to be hardened before production)


TO DO BEFORE PRODUCTION RELEASE
• Step 1 — Get service role key
In Supabase Dashboard → Settings → API → copy the service_role key. Keep this secret — never put it in the patched APK, only in the admin app.
• Step 2 — Update admin app to use service role key
In KotlinLicenseRepository.kt, add a second constant and swap it in for all write operations (syncProductToCloud, syncLicenseToCloud, pushToRevocationsTable, deleteProductFromCloud/cloudDelete):

private const val SERVICE_KEY = "your_service_role_key_here"

Replace ANON_KEY with SERVICE_KEY in every setRequestProperty("apikey", ...) and setRequestProperty("Authorization", "Bearer ...") call inside those write functions. The patched app's SHVLicense and SHVAccount keep using ANON_KEY since they only read

• Step 3 — Re-enable RLS on all 4 tables
In Supabase Dashboard → Table Editor → each of the 4 tables → enable RLS.
• Step 4 — Run this SQL in Supabase SQL Editor

-- kl_products: patched app can read, nobody can write via anon
CREATE POLICY "anon_read" ON kl_products 
    FOR SELECT TO anon USING (true);

-- kl_licenses: patched app can read to verify/check revocation status
CREATE POLICY "anon_read" ON kl_licenses 
    FOR SELECT TO anon USING (true);

-- kl_revocations: patched app can read to check revocation fallback
CREATE POLICY "anon_read" ON kl_revocations 
    FOR SELECT TO anon USING (true);

-- kl_demo_sessions: authenticated users can insert their own session and read it
CREATE POLICY "auth_insert" ON kl_demo_sessions 
    FOR INSERT TO authenticated WITH CHECK (true);
CREATE POLICY "auth_read" ON kl_demo_sessions 
    FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (true);


• Step 5 — Rebuild and test admin app with service role key
Create product → should appear in kl_products ✓
Generate and revoke license → should update kl_licenses ✓
Delete product → all 4 tables should cascade ✓

• Step 6 — Test patched app still works
Trial start → should still work (authenticated user) ✓
License activation → should still work (reads only) ✓
Revocation detection → should still work (reads only) ✓


SECURITY POSTURE AFTER HARDENING
Anon key in patched APK can only read — cannot write or manipulate any table
All writes go through service role key which is only in the admin app
License validity is still cryptographically enforced by RSA signature — Supabase manipulation cannot forge a valid license regardless of table access
Demo sessions tied to authenticated user account — cannot be inflated anonymously



--- GO TO ceo.shvertex@gmail.com CLAUDE TO DO THESE UPDATES ---



Updates : Once the product gets deleted, the license gets activated again....

SHV_LicenseGate_PaymentRoadmap.txt.content:
================================================================================
  KOTLIN LICENSE GATE — PAYMENT & FULFILLMENT ROADMAP
  SH Vertex Technologies — Slackline Admin App
  Prepared for: Iekke
================================================================================


────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
FINAL CUSTOMER FLOW
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

1. Customer launches patched app → hits License Gate screen
2. Signs in with SH Vertex account → starts free trial (one time, device bound)
3. Trial expires → gate shows "Upgrade to Pro" with price displayed
4. Customer taps preferred payment method → pays
5. Customer taps "I've Paid" → WhatsApp or Email opens with pre-composed
   message containing app name, device code, and payment reference
6. You receive notification → immediately extend their trial grace period
   from admin app (6 hours) → reply confirming receipt
7. You verify payment → generate Pro license key in admin app →
   send key back via same channel
8. Customer pastes key into gate screen → activates → permanent access
9. Key is device-bound, cryptographically signed, revocable anytime
   from admin app


────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
PAYMENT METHODS TO IMPLEMENT
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

BANK TRANSFER
  Status  : Already ready
  Needed  : Bank name, account number, account name, branch, SWIFT code
  Display : On gate screen — customer sends proof via WhatsApp or Email
  Fees    : Zero
  Setup   : Zero

CRYPTO
  Status  : Already ready
  Wallets needed:
    - USDT  (BSC / TRC20 / Plasma — specify network clearly on screen)
    - ETH
    - LTC   (low fees, preferred)
  Display : Each address shown with network label
  Proof   : Customer sends transaction hash
  Fees    : Zero on your end
  Risk    : Zero chargeback

PAYHERE  (Sri Lanka — LKR)
  Status      : Pending registration
  Register at : payhere.lk
  Requirements: NIC, bank account details, website (shvertex.online),
                business description
  You get     : Merchant ID + Merchant Secret + hosted payment link per product
  Approval    : A few days
  Commission  : ~2.7% per transaction
  For v1      : Just the hosted payment link URL — no API integration needed

STRIPE  (International — USD / GBP / EUR)
  Status      : Pending registration
  Register at : stripe.com
  Requirements: Identity verification, bank account
  You get     : Publishable Key + Secret Key + no-code Payment Link URL
  For v1      : Just the hosted payment link URL per product —
                no webhook or backend needed
  Commission  : 1.5% + $0.30 per international transaction


────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
THE GRACE PERIOD SYSTEM
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

HOW IT WORKS:
  - Payment notification received
  - Admin triggers trial extension for that device from admin app
  - Extension duration : 6 hours (covers 4 hour delivery commitment + buffer)
  - Technical action   : PATCH to kl_demo_sessions updating demo_expires_at
                         for the customer's device code
  - Customer keeps using the app uninterrupted while you process payment
  - No locked screen, no anxiety — premium experience
  - Key arrives before grace expires → seamless activation

WHY THIS IS SMART:
  - Customer never sits at a locked screen waiting
  - You have breathing room without any pressure
  - 4 hour promise is comfortable with a 6 hour grace window
  - Same system already built — just one new admin action needed


────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
WHAT NEEDS TO BE BUILT  (one session when ready)
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

IN THE LICENSE GATE SCREEN (generated by injector):

  - "Buy Pro License" section showing price
  - Clear disclaimer:
      "Pay first via your preferred method. Notify us after payment.
       Key delivered within 4 hours. Your trial will be extended
       immediately upon payment confirmation."
  - Payment method selector — Bank Transfer, Crypto, PayHere, Stripe
  - Each method shows relevant details (account / wallet / payment link)
  - "I've Paid" button per method → opens WhatsApp or Email with
    pre-composed message:

      "Hello, I've paid for a Pro License for {app name}.
       Device Code: {deviceCode}.
       Payment method: {method}.
       Reference / TxHash: [customer fills this in].
       Please process my key."

IN THE ADMIN APP:

  - "Extend Trial Grace" action
  - Input: device code + extension duration
  - One tap → patches kl_demo_sessions.demo_expires_at
  - Can live in KotlinProductManagerScreen under license actions
    or as a dedicated quick-action panel


────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
INFORMATION TO HAVE READY WHEN YOU RETURN
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  [ ] Bank name
  [ ] Account number
  [ ] Account name
  [ ] Branch
  [ ] SWIFT code

  [ ] USDT wallet address — BSC network
  [ ] USDT wallet address — TRC20 network
  [ ] USDT wallet address — Plasma network
  [ ] ETH wallet address
  [ ] LTC wallet address

  [ ] PayHere Merchant ID
  [ ] PayHere hosted payment link URL (one per product)

  [ ] Stripe hosted payment link URL (one per product)

  [ ] Confirmed response time promise      (currently: 4 hours)
  [ ] Confirmed grace extension duration   (currently: 6 hours)
  [ ] Any additional payment methods to add


────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
CURRENT SYSTEM STATUS  (already working)
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  [✓] Product creation + cloud sync to kl_products
  [✓] Injection generates all gate files cleanly
  [✓] Trial sessions write to kl_demo_sessions
  [✓] License activation with RSA crypto verification
  [✓] Revocation detection on next launch
  [✓] Product deletion cascades all 4 tables
  [✓] License cleared when product deleted
  [✓] AMOLED gate UI with price display
  [✓] Request Pro via WhatsApp / Email with device code pre-filled
  [✓] Create Account redirect to shvertex.online
  [✓] Admin app uses SERVICE_KEY for all writes
  [✓] RLS enabled — anon read only, authenticated demo insert
  [✓] Service key never shipped in patched APKs


────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
PENDING  (complete before production release)
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  [ ] PayHere registration + approval
  [ ] Stripe registration + approval
  [ ] Build payment section in license gate screen
  [ ] Build grace extension tool in admin app
  [ ] Final end-to-end test with real payment


────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
SUPABASE RLS POLICIES  (already applied — for reference)
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  -- Enable RLS
  ALTER TABLE kl_products       ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
  ALTER TABLE kl_licenses       ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
  ALTER TABLE kl_revocations    ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
  ALTER TABLE kl_demo_sessions  ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

  -- kl_products: patched app reads to verify product exists
  CREATE POLICY "anon_read" ON kl_products
      FOR SELECT TO anon USING (true);

  -- kl_licenses: patched app reads to check revocation status
  CREATE POLICY "anon_read" ON kl_licenses
      FOR SELECT TO anon USING (true);

  -- kl_revocations: patched app reads for revocation fallback check
  CREATE POLICY "anon_read" ON kl_revocations
      FOR SELECT TO anon USING (true);

  -- kl_demo_sessions: authenticated users insert and read their own sessions
  CREATE POLICY "auth_insert" ON kl_demo_sessions
      FOR INSERT TO authenticated WITH CHECK (true);
  CREATE POLICY "auth_read" ON kl_demo_sessions
      FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (true);


────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
NOTES
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  - Admin app uses SERVICE_KEY (sb_secret_...) for all writes — bypasses RLS
  - Patched APKs use ANON_KEY (sb_publishable_...) — read only, safe to ship
  - License keys are RSA signed — Supabase manipulation cannot forge a valid key
  - All crypto/bank/payment details are baked into each APK at injection time
  - Grace extension is a PATCH on kl_demo_sessions.demo_expires_at only

================================================================================
